title: Turbulence inflow eddy viscosity
overview: Supplies the inflow eddy-viscosity quantity mutoo in the audited two-equation turbulence inflow initialization path. It participates with Reynolds number and reference density in deriving inflow turbulence variables.
principle: The source computes k_e = mutoo * kwoo / (cmu * Reynolds * rho_ref). When positive inflow intensity is supplied, it recomputes k_e from intensity and derives kwoo from mutoo and the same reference factors.
architecture: TurbCom::Init reads inflow_viscosity. TurbCom::InitInflow assigns mutoo = inflow_viscosity and uses it in the two-equation branch. Dimensional convention and valid range remain unresolved.

proves: The two-equation inflow initializer assigns mutoo = inflow_viscosity.
The initializer combines mutoo, Reynolds number, reference density, and model constants to derive inflow turbulence variables.
does_not_prove: That the relation applies to the one-equation SA branch.
The dimensional unit convention or admissible range.
A universal default or measured boundary-condition accuracy.

verification.scope: Declaration linkage is not a record of execution or numerical validation.

formulas.title: Inflow eddy-viscosity relation
formulas.assumptions: Initial relation in the two-equation branch of TurbCom::InitInflow; positive intensity subsequently recomputes k_e and kwoo.

symbols.meaning: Reference Reynolds number used by the inflow initializer.

symbols.notes: Read from the flow inflow state.

caveats: The formula documents the audited source branch; it is not a universal model identity or a recommended parameter setting.
